summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share repurchases under its existing buyback programme. The issuer bought 3.73 million ordinary shares on 12-15 May 2026 via UBS at weighted average prices of 558.72-566.00 GBp per share. Shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. The buyback is a capital return to shareholders. No special situation otherwise; it is a routine execution update. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and impact on EPS.
